description: Ministry of Industries - The Societies Ordinance - The Society known as Ceylon Safety Match Manufactuers Association Kundasale - The Societies known as Usan Foundation Mirusuvil
categorisation: This gazette notification exercises powers under the Societies Ordinance (Chapter 123) to authorize purposes and limit application of the ordinance for specific societies. It involves regulatory matters and legal provisions (Sections 3 & 4), making it primarily about legal/regulatory framework rather than government personnel, organizational changes, or other specialized categories.
